title: Project Falcon: LOI delivered (draft v4, final per Friday discussion)

messages.content:
HARBOR LANE PARTNERS | PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL
PROJECT FALCON: LOI DELIVERED (DRAFT v4, FINAL per Friday discussion)

To: Falcon deal team
Cc: Maya (compliance)
From: Dan
Date: 2026-10-28
Re: LOI out this morning; closing the open items from v3

1. LOI delivered to the Nimbus board this morning, 2026-10-28, ahead of their board meeting tomorrow, 2026-10-29. Terms as discussed: $38.50 per NMBL share in cash, 45 days exclusivity, no financing condition.

2. Break fee: resolved at 2.75% of equity value, splitting the difference with Corvane's GC from Friday's call. Closes the open item from v3.

3. Earnout: confirmed removed from the model. Corvane's GC signed off; no earnout language in the LOI.

4. Diligence:
- Quality of earnings: Ashby & Rowe kickoff moved up, starts 2026-10-29.
- Customer concentration: Nimbus agreed to a call with their top customer (22% of revenue, contract renews 2027-03-31), scheduled 2026-11-03. [Dan: get Corvane on that call too]
- Labor: Memphis hub union contract (expires 2027-06-30) confirmed stable, no early renegotiation planned per management.
- Real estate: of the three hubs on leases rolling in 2027, Memphis auto-renews absent 180 days' notice from either side; the other two remain open and are now part of the QoE scope.

5. Timeline unchanged: target signing mid-December, announce alongside Nimbus Q4 results if timing allows.

6. Wall: same as v3. Maya keeps the Falcon wall list. Do NOT discuss Falcon on #hl-floor or with research or the desk.
